source.zh-CN: MindScope 项目自编（2026）。尚未经过常模与效度验证，结果仅供自我了解参考。不是官方 MBTI 量表。
source.en: Written by the MindScope project (2026). Not yet validated against norms; results are for self-reflection only. Not the official MBTI instrument.

text.zh-CN: 在热闹的聚会结束后，我通常觉得精力更充沛了。
text.en: After a lively gathering, I usually feel more energized than before.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢边说边想，把想法讲出来能帮我理清思路。
text.en: I like to think out loud; talking helps me sort out my thoughts.

text.zh-CN: 在一群不太熟的人中，我通常会主动开启话题。
text.en: Among people I don't know well, I usually start the conversation.

text.zh-CN: 空闲的周末，我更愿意约朋友出去而不是待在家里。
text.en: On a free weekend, I would rather go out with friends than stay at home.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢同时认识很多不同的人。
text.en: I enjoy getting to know many different people at the same time.

text.zh-CN: 小组讨论时，我通常是比较早发言的人之一。
text.en: In group discussions, I am usually one of the first to speak.

text.zh-CN: 一个人独处太久会让我觉得闷。
text.en: Spending a long time alone makes me feel restless.

text.zh-CN: 我很享受成为大家注意力的中心。
text.en: I enjoy being the center of attention.

text.zh-CN: 遇到问题时，我倾向于先找人聊聊。
text.en: When I face a problem, my first move is usually to talk it through with someone.

text.zh-CN: 我在热闹、有人来往的环境中做事效率更高。
text.en: I get more done in a lively place with people coming and going.

text.zh-CN: 别人通常很快就能知道我在想什么。
text.en: People usually find out quickly what I am thinking.

text.zh-CN: 我很容易和陌生人聊起来。
text.en: I find it easy to strike up a chat with strangers.

text.zh-CN: 一天中如果有很多社交活动，我反而感到更有活力。
text.en: A day full of social activities leaves me feeling more lively, not less.

text.zh-CN: 我更喜欢通过参与和行动来了解一件事，而不是先在心里想清楚。
text.en: I prefer to understand things by jumping in and taking part rather than thinking them through first.

text.zh-CN: 加入一个新团体时，我很快就能融入。
text.en: When I join a new group, I fit in quickly.

text.zh-CN: 和很多人相处一整天后，我需要独处一段时间来恢复精力。
text.en: After a full day with many people, I need time alone to recharge.

text.zh-CN: 比起参加大型聚会，我更喜欢和一两个好朋友深入交谈。
text.en: I prefer deep conversations with one or two close friends to big parties.

text.zh-CN: 发言之前，我通常会先在心里把想法想清楚。
text.en: Before speaking, I usually think my ideas through in my head.

text.zh-CN: 我习惯先自己消化情绪和想法，再决定要不要跟别人说。
text.en: I usually process my feelings and thoughts on my own before deciding whether to share them.

text.zh-CN: 电话突然响起时，我常常希望对方改发消息。
text.en: When the phone rings unexpectedly, I often wish the person had sent a message instead.

text.zh-CN: 在会议上，我常常是听得多、说得少的那个人。
text.en: In meetings, I am often the one who listens more than talks.

text.zh-CN: 别人需要相处一段时间才能真正了解我。
text.en: It takes people a while to really get to know me.

text.zh-CN: 太多的社交安排会让我感到疲惫。
text.en: Too many social plans wear me out.

text.zh-CN: 我更愿意用文字来表达复杂的想法。
text.en: I prefer to express complicated ideas in writing.

text.zh-CN: 我的朋友圈子不大，但关系都很深。
text.en: My circle of friends is small, but the bonds are deep.

text.zh-CN: 在嘈杂、人多的地方待久了，我会很想找个安静的角落。
text.en: After a while in a noisy, crowded place, I want to find a quiet corner.

text.zh-CN: 我通常只和熟悉的人分享自己的私事。
text.en: I usually share personal matters only with people I know well.

text.zh-CN: 假期里，我更想安安静静地休息，而不是排满活动。
text.en: On holiday, I would rather rest quietly than fill the days with activities.

text.zh-CN: 到了一个新群体，我通常要先观察一段时间才会加入谈话。
text.en: In a new group, I usually watch for a while before joining the conversation.

text.zh-CN: 独处的时光对我来说是一种享受，而不是孤单。
text.en: Time alone feels like a treat to me, not like loneliness.

text.zh-CN: 我更信任亲身经历过的事实，而不是推测。
text.en: I trust facts I have experienced more than speculation.

text.zh-CN: 学习新东西时，我喜欢先看具体的例子。
text.en: When learning something new, I like to start with concrete examples.

text.zh-CN: 做事时，我会特别留意细节。
text.en: When I work on something, I pay special attention to the details.

text.zh-CN: 我更喜欢按已经被证明有效的方法做事。
text.en: I prefer to do things in ways that are proven to work.

text.zh-CN: 描述一件事时，我倾向于说清楚具体发生了什么，而不是它意味着什么。
text.en: When describing an event, I tend to say exactly what happened rather than what it means.

text.zh-CN: 比起讨论抽象的理论，我更喜欢解决实际的问题。
text.en: I would rather solve practical problems than discuss abstract theories.

text.zh-CN: 我比较关注当下，而不是很久以后的可能性。
text.en: I focus more on the here and now than on possibilities far in the future.

text.zh-CN: 有明确、一步一步的说明时，我做事最顺手。
text.en: I work best with clear, step-by-step instructions.

text.zh-CN: 我能记住很多具体的事实和数字。
text.en: I easily remember specific facts and figures.

text.zh-CN: 别人说话太绕或太抽象时，我会希望他们讲得直接具体一点。
text.en: When people talk in vague or abstract terms, I wish they would be more direct and concrete.

text.zh-CN: 我欣赏实用、经久耐用的东西胜过新奇的设计。
text.en: I value things that are practical and durable over things that are merely novel.

text.zh-CN: 我很快就会注意到周围环境的变化，比如声音、气味或物品的摆放。
text.en: I quickly notice changes in my surroundings, such as sounds, smells or how things are arranged.

text.zh-CN: 做决定时，我主要依据现有的数据和经验。
text.en: When deciding, I rely mainly on the data and experience at hand.

text.zh-CN: 比起不断尝试新东西，我更喜欢把一项技能练到熟练。
text.en: I prefer to master one skill thoroughly rather than keep trying new things.

text.zh-CN: 读一本书时，我更关注情节和事实，而不是隐藏的象征意义。
text.en: When reading a book, I focus on the plot and facts rather than hidden symbolism.

text.zh-CN: 我经常会想“如果……会怎样”。
text.en: I often find myself wondering "what if…?"

text.zh-CN: 我很容易注意到事物之间不明显的联系。
text.en: I easily notice connections between things that others miss.

text.zh-CN: 比起事实本身，我更感兴趣的是它背后的意义。
text.en: I am more interested in what facts mean than in the facts themselves.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢讨论抽象的理论和概念。
text.en: I enjoy discussing abstract theories and concepts.

text.zh-CN: 我常常凭直觉就知道事情会怎么发展，虽然说不清理由。
text.en: I often sense how things will turn out, even when I can't explain why.

text.zh-CN: 一成不变的重复性工作很快会让我厌倦。
text.en: Repetitive routine work bores me quickly.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢用比喻和类比来解释事情。
text.en: I like to explain things with metaphors and analogies.

text.zh-CN: 比起眼前的细节，我对未来的各种可能性更感兴趣。
text.en: Future possibilities interest me more than present details.

text.zh-CN: 读说明书时，我常常跳过细节，先把握整体思路。
text.en: When reading instructions, I often skip the details and grab the overall idea first.

text.zh-CN: 我经常冒出新点子，但不一定每个都去落实。
text.en: I often come up with new ideas, though I don't carry all of them out.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢尝试用新的方式做熟悉的事情。
text.en: I like trying new ways of doing familiar things.

text.zh-CN: 别人有时觉得我的想法太跳跃，不容易跟上。
text.en: People sometimes find my thinking hard to follow because it jumps around.

text.zh-CN: 我常常在脑海中想象一件事将来可能变成的样子。
text.en: I often picture in my mind what something could become.

text.zh-CN: 评价一个方案时，我很看重它是否有创意，而不只是是否稳妥。
text.en: When judging a plan, I care about how original it is, not just how safe it is.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢探索还没有标准答案的问题。
text.en: I enjoy exploring questions that do not have a standard answer yet.

text.zh-CN: 做重要决定时，我主要依据逻辑和客观分析。
text.en: When making important decisions, I rely mainly on logic and objective analysis.

text.zh-CN: 我认为指出别人的错误是必要的，即使会让人不舒服。
text.en: I think pointing out mistakes is necessary, even if it makes people uncomfortable.

text.zh-CN: 我更看重一个结论是否正确，而不是大家是否认同。
text.en: I care more about whether a conclusion is correct than whether everyone agrees with it.

text.zh-CN: 在争论中，我更关注观点本身，而不太顾及对方的感受。
text.en: In a debate, I focus on the argument itself more than on how the other person feels.

text.zh-CN: 我认为规则应该对每个人一视同仁，不应因人而异。
text.en: I believe rules should apply equally to everyone, without exceptions for personal circumstances.

text.zh-CN: 别人向我倾诉问题时，我的第一反应通常是想办法解决。
text.en: When someone shares a problem with me, my first instinct is to look for a solution.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢用数据和证据来说服别人。
text.en: I like to persuade people with data and evidence.

text.zh-CN: 即使是朋友提出的方案，我也能冷静地指出其中的问题。
text.en: I can calmly point out problems in a plan even when a friend proposed it.

text.zh-CN: 评价一个人的工作时，我主要看结果和效率。
text.en: When judging someone's work, I look mainly at results and efficiency.

text.zh-CN: 我相信大多数问题都能通过理性分析找到最好的答案。
text.en: I believe most problems can be best solved through rational analysis.

text.zh-CN: 比起被称赞“有爱心”，我更希望被称赞“有能力”。
text.en: I would rather be praised as capable than as kind-hearted.

text.zh-CN: 做选择时，我会尽量把个人感情放在一边。
text.en: When choosing, I try to set my personal feelings aside.

text.zh-CN: 我说话比较直接，觉得绕弯子是在浪费时间。
text.en: I speak directly; beating around the bush seems like a waste of time.

text.zh-CN: 遇到冲突时，我先想的是谁对谁错。
text.en: In a conflict, my first question is who is right and who is wrong.

text.zh-CN: 做判断时，我更相信客观标准，而不是个人好恶。
text.en: In my judgments, I trust objective standards over personal likes and dislikes.

text.zh-CN: 做决定时，我会认真考虑它对相关的人有什么影响。
text.en: When deciding, I think carefully about how it will affect the people involved.

text.zh-CN: 我很在意身边的人是否相处融洽。
text.en: I care a lot about whether the people around me get along.

text.zh-CN: 即使我有道理，也不太愿意说出可能伤人的话。
text.en: Even when I'm right, I hesitate to say things that might hurt someone.

text.zh-CN: 我常常能感受到别人没有说出口的情绪。
text.en: I often sense feelings that others leave unspoken.

text.zh-CN: 我认为在某些情况下，体谅和人情比规则更重要。
text.en: I think that in some situations, understanding and compassion matter more than rules.

text.zh-CN: 朋友向我倾诉时，我首先想做的是倾听和安慰。
text.en: When a friend confides in me, my first wish is to listen and comfort.

text.zh-CN: 做选择时，我常常会问自己“这符合我看重的东西吗”。
text.en: When choosing, I often ask myself whether it fits what I truly value.

text.zh-CN: 别人批评我的时候，我比较容易往心里去。
text.en: I tend to take criticism to heart.

text.zh-CN: 一个真实的故事比一组统计数据更能打动我。
text.en: A true personal story moves me more than a set of statistics.

text.zh-CN: 为了维护一段关系，我愿意做出一些让步。
text.en: I'm willing to give some ground to keep a relationship healthy.

text.zh-CN: 别人的赞扬和鼓励对我做事的动力影响很大。
text.en: Praise and encouragement strongly affect my motivation.

text.zh-CN: 评价一个人时，我会考虑他的出发点和难处。
text.en: When judging someone, I take their intentions and difficulties into account.

text.zh-CN: 看到别人难过，我很难置身事外。
text.en: When I see someone upset, it is hard for me to stay uninvolved.

text.zh-CN: 对我来说，一个决定“感觉对”很重要。
text.en: It matters to me that a decision feels right.

text.zh-CN: 在团队里，我常常是那个照顾大家情绪的人。
text.en: In a team, I am often the one who looks after everyone's feelings.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢提前做好计划，而不是到时候再说。
text.en: I like to plan ahead rather than decide on the spot.

text.zh-CN: 我通常会提前完成任务，而不是拖到截止日期前。
text.en: I usually finish tasks well before the deadline.

text.zh-CN: 有一份待办清单会让我感到踏实。
text.en: Having a to-do list makes me feel settled.

text.zh-CN: 事情悬而未决会让我感到不安。
text.en: Leaving things undecided makes me uneasy.

text.zh-CN: 我的房间和桌面通常整理得比较有条理。
text.en: My room and desk are usually well organized.

text.zh-CN: 出门旅行前，我会把行程大致安排好。
text.en: Before a trip, I roughly plan the itinerary.

text.zh-CN: 计划被突然打乱时，我会比较烦躁。
text.en: I get irritated when my plans are suddenly disrupted.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢先把工作做完，再去放松娱乐。
text.en: I prefer to finish my work before I relax.

text.zh-CN: 做出决定后，我倾向于坚持执行，而不是反复调整。
text.en: Once I decide, I tend to stick with it rather than keep adjusting.

text.zh-CN: 我习惯按固定的作息和流程生活。
text.en: I like to live by a regular routine.

text.zh-CN: 我希望事情尽早有一个明确的结论。
text.en: I like things to be clearly settled as early as possible.

text.zh-CN: 同时开了很多头却没有完成，会让我很难受。
text.en: Starting many things without finishing them really bothers me.

text.zh-CN: 我会为重要的事情预留出充足的时间。
text.en: I set aside plenty of time for important matters.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢事先知道接下来会发生什么。
text.en: I like knowing in advance what will happen next.

text.zh-CN: 我会把约会和截止日期记在日历上。
text.en: I keep my appointments and deadlines in a calendar.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢保留选择的余地，不急于做决定。
text.en: I like to keep my options open rather than decide quickly.

text.zh-CN: 截止日期临近时，我反而效率最高。
text.en: I do my best work when the deadline is close.

text.zh-CN: 计划临时改变时，我通常能很快适应，甚至觉得有趣。
text.en: When plans change at the last minute, I adapt quickly and may even enjoy it.

text.zh-CN: 我更喜欢说走就走的旅行。
text.en: I prefer spontaneous trips.

text.zh-CN: 太多的规矩和流程会让我觉得被束缚。
text.en: Too many rules and procedures make me feel boxed in.

text.zh-CN: 我常常同时进行好几件事，想到哪做到哪。
text.en: I often juggle several things at once, following whatever catches my interest.

text.zh-CN: 即使已经做了决定，有了新信息我也乐意改变。
text.en: Even after deciding, I'm happy to change my mind when new information comes up.

text.zh-CN: 我的桌面经常有点乱，但我知道东西在哪。
text.en: My desk is often a bit messy, but I know where things are.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢边做边看，而不是事先把一切都计划好。
text.en: I like to figure things out as I go rather than plan everything in advance.

text.zh-CN: 固定不变的日程安排会让我觉得无聊。
text.en: A fixed, unchanging schedule bores me.

text.zh-CN: 我做事常常看心情和兴致。
text.en: What I do often depends on my mood and interest.

text.zh-CN: 我觉得过早下结论可能会错过更好的选择。
text.en: I feel that settling too early can mean missing a better option.

text.zh-CN: 比起按清单做事，我更喜欢随机应变。
text.en: I would rather improvise than follow a checklist.

text.zh-CN: 我享受工作和生活中出现的意外和变化。
text.en: I enjoy surprises and changes in work and life.

text.zh-CN: 收拾整理对我来说不是要优先做的事。
text.en: Tidying up is not a high priority for me.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢能调动五感的体验，比如美食、音乐、运动。
text.en: I love experiences that engage all my senses, like good food, music or sports.

text.zh-CN: 在紧急情况下，我能迅速做出反应并采取行动。
text.en: In an emergency, I react quickly and take action.

text.zh-CN: 我很享受全身心投入当下正在发生的事情。
text.en: I enjoy being fully absorbed in whatever is happening right now.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢刺激、带点冒险的活动。
text.en: I enjoy thrilling activities with a bit of risk.

text.zh-CN: 我很擅长在现场随机应变地处理问题。
text.en: I am good at handling problems on the spot as they come up.

text.zh-CN: 我对外观、颜色和质感很敏锐，比如穿搭和布置。
text.en: I am sharp about looks, colors and textures, for example in clothes or decoration.

text.zh-CN: 比起读说明书，我更愿意直接上手试一试。
text.en: Rather than read the manual, I'd rather just try it with my hands.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢马上行动，并且很快看到结果。
text.en: I like to act right away and see results quickly.

text.zh-CN: 身体运动和户外活动能让我恢复精力。
text.en: Physical activity and time outdoors restore my energy.

text.zh-CN: 我常常想得太入神，以至于忽略了身边正在发生的事。
text.en: I often get so lost in thought that I miss what is going on around me.

text.zh-CN: 我需要先想清楚才行动，很少凭一时的冲动做事。
text.en: I need to think things through before acting and rarely act on impulse.

text.zh-CN: 我不太在意衣着和周围环境好不好看。
text.en: I don't pay much attention to how clothes or surroundings look.

text.zh-CN: 遇到新情况时，我会自然地拿它和以前的经历作比较。
text.en: In a new situation, I naturally compare it with past experiences.

text.zh-CN: 我对过去发生的事记得很清楚，包括很多细节。
text.en: I remember past events clearly, including many details.

text.zh-CN: 熟悉的环境、食物和习惯让我感到安心。
text.en: Familiar places, foods and habits give me a sense of security.

text.zh-CN: 我很重视传统和惯例，觉得它们有存在的道理。
text.en: I value traditions and customs; I think they exist for good reasons.

text.zh-CN: 我很清楚自己身体的状态，比如累了、饿了或不舒服。
text.en: I am very aware of my body's state, such as being tired, hungry or unwell.

text.zh-CN: 答应别人的事，我会一丝不苟地做到。
text.en: When I promise something, I follow through carefully.

text.zh-CN: 我习惯保留旧物和纪念品，因为它们承载着回忆。
text.en: I like to keep old things and keepsakes because they hold memories.

text.zh-CN: 我会定期回顾过去的记录，比如日记、照片或账单。
text.en: I regularly look back over past records such as diaries, photos or bills.

text.zh-CN: 我能察觉到事情和以前相比有哪些细微的不同。
text.en: I notice small ways in which things differ from how they used to be.

text.zh-CN: 我很少回想过去，更多关注接下来要做什么。
text.en: I rarely think about the past; I focus on what comes next.

text.zh-CN: 过去的细节我常常记不太清楚。
text.en: I often don't remember details of the past very well.

text.zh-CN: 我不太在意传统的做法，觉得新办法往往更好。
text.en: I don't care much for traditional ways; new approaches are often better.

text.zh-CN: 和别人讨论时，我的新点子会一个接一个地冒出来。
text.en: In discussions, ideas pop into my head one after another.

text.zh-CN: 我对很多不同领域都感兴趣，喜欢在它们之间跨界联想。
text.en: I'm interested in many fields and like making links across them.

text.zh-CN: 看到一样东西，我会想到它的很多种用法。
text.en: When I see an object, I think of many ways it could be used.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢头脑风暴，想法越天马行空越好。
text.en: I love brainstorming, and the wilder the ideas the better.

text.zh-CN: 新的项目和可能性会让我很兴奋。
text.en: New projects and possibilities excite me.

text.zh-CN: 对同一件事，我常常能看到好几种解释。
text.en: I can often see several interpretations of the same event.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢和别人碰撞想法，互相启发。
text.en: I like bouncing ideas off other people.

text.zh-CN: 别人眼中的问题，我常常能看到其中的机会。
text.en: Where others see a problem, I often see an opportunity.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢问：“还有没有别的办法？”
text.en: I like asking, "Is there another way?"

text.zh-CN: 太多的选择和可能性会让我觉得思路混乱。
text.en: Too many options and possibilities leave my thinking muddled.

text.zh-CN: 我很少冒出与当前话题无关的新想法。
text.en: I rarely come up with ideas unrelated to the topic at hand.

text.zh-CN: 对还没被证实的新点子，我通常持保留态度。
text.en: I am usually skeptical of new ideas that haven't been proven.

text.zh-CN: 我常常会突然“想通”一件事，整体的图景一下子变得清晰。
text.en: Things often suddenly click for me, and the whole picture becomes clear at once.

text.zh-CN: 我心里常有一个长远的目标，做的事都围绕它展开。
text.en: I usually have a long-term goal in mind, and what I do is arranged around it.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢深入思考事物背后的本质。
text.en: I like to reflect deeply on the essence behind things.

text.zh-CN: 我常常能从复杂的信息中提炼出一个核心结论。
text.en: I can often distill one core conclusion from complex information.

text.zh-CN: 我对象征、梦境或隐喻背后的含义很感兴趣。
text.en: I'm interested in the meaning behind symbols, dreams or metaphors.

text.zh-CN: 我常常比别人更早看出一种趋势正在形成。
text.en: I often notice a trend forming earlier than others do.

text.zh-CN: 我需要安静的时间，让想法在心里慢慢成形。
text.en: I need quiet time to let my ideas take shape inside me.

text.zh-CN: 比起了解很多事，我更想把一件事看透。
text.en: I would rather understand one thing deeply than know a little about many.

text.zh-CN: 我常常在脑海中预演未来可能出现的情景。
text.en: I often rehearse possible future scenarios in my mind.

text.zh-CN: 我很少去想事情背后更深的含义。
text.en: I rarely think about the deeper meaning behind events.

text.zh-CN: 对我来说，长远的愿景没有眼前的任务重要。
text.en: To me, long-term visions matter less than the task in front of me.

text.zh-CN: 我更相信看得见的证据，而不是自己的预感。
text.en: I trust visible evidence more than my own hunches.

text.zh-CN: 我擅长把杂乱的任务整理成清晰的计划并分配下去。
text.en: I'm good at turning a jumble of tasks into a clear plan and handing them out.

text.zh-CN: 我很看重效率，不喜欢浪费时间和资源。
text.en: I value efficiency and dislike wasting time and resources.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢为目标设定可以衡量的标准。
text.en: I like setting measurable targets for my goals.

text.zh-CN: 团队没有方向时，我会主动站出来做决定。
text.en: When a team lacks direction, I step up and make decisions.

text.zh-CN: 我判断一个办法好不好，主要看它是否管用。
text.en: I judge a method mainly by whether it gets results.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢用流程、表格和工具来管理事情。
text.en: I like managing things with processes, spreadsheets and tools.

text.zh-CN: 我能很快做出决断并推动执行。
text.en: I can make decisions quickly and push them through.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢负责组织活动或项目，让一切按计划运转。
text.en: I like being in charge of organizing events or projects so that everything runs to plan.

text.zh-CN: 一场会议如果没有明确的结论，我会觉得是浪费时间。
text.en: A meeting without a clear conclusion feels like a waste of time to me.

text.zh-CN: 我不太喜欢去管理或指挥别人做事。
text.en: I don't much like managing or directing other people.

text.zh-CN: 我不太在乎事情是否高效，过程本身更让我享受。
text.en: I don't care much about efficiency; I enjoy the process itself.

text.zh-CN: 我不喜欢用量化的指标去衡量事情。
text.en: I dislike measuring things with numerical indicators.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢搞清楚一样东西为什么会这样运作。
text.en: I like figuring out why something works the way it does.

text.zh-CN: 别人用词不准确时，我会忍不住想纠正。
text.en: When people use words imprecisely, I'm tempted to correct them.

text.zh-CN: 我习惯在心里建立一套自己的逻辑体系来理解世界。
text.en: I tend to build my own logical framework to make sense of the world.

text.zh-CN: 我能很快发现一个论证中的漏洞或矛盾。
text.en: I quickly spot gaps or contradictions in an argument.

text.zh-CN: 即使是权威的说法，我也要自己想明白才会接受。
text.en: Even when an authority says something, I accept it only after reasoning it through myself.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢把复杂的问题拆解成最基本的组成部分。
text.en: I like breaking complex problems down into their basic parts.

text.zh-CN: 我享受独自钻研一个难题的过程。
text.en: I enjoy working on a hard problem by myself.

text.zh-CN: 我更在乎一个想法在逻辑上是否自洽，而不是它是否实用。
text.en: I care more about whether an idea is logically consistent than whether it is practical.

text.zh-CN: 解释事情时，我喜欢从基本原理讲起。
text.en: When explaining something, I like to start from first principles.

text.zh-CN: 只要方法管用，我不太在意背后的原理。
text.en: As long as something works, I don't much care about the theory behind it.

text.zh-CN: 我很少去推敲别人话里的逻辑。
text.en: I rarely examine the logic of what people say.

text.zh-CN: 深入分析抽象的逻辑问题会让我觉得枯燥。
text.en: Analyzing abstract logical problems in depth bores me.

text.zh-CN: 我能很快察觉到一群人中气氛的变化。
text.en: I quickly notice changes in the mood of a group.

text.zh-CN: 我会自然地调整自己的言行，让身边的人感到舒服。
text.en: I naturally adjust what I say and do so that people around me feel comfortable.

text.zh-CN: 我很注重礼节，觉得它能让人与人相处更顺畅。
text.en: I care about good manners; they help people get along smoothly.

text.zh-CN: 看到集体里有人被冷落，我会想办法让他融入。
text.en: When someone is left out in a group, I try to bring them in.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢通过表达关心和赞赏让别人开心。
text.en: I like making people happy by showing care and appreciation.

text.zh-CN: 做决定时，我会考虑大家是否都能接受。
text.en: When deciding, I consider whether everyone can accept it.

text.zh-CN: 我擅长调解别人之间的矛盾。
text.en: I'm good at smoothing over conflicts between others.

text.zh-CN: 我会特意记住别人的生日或喜好。
text.en: I make a point of remembering people's birthdays or preferences.

text.zh-CN: 团队士气低落时，我会想办法鼓舞大家。
text.en: When team morale is low, I try to lift everyone up.

text.zh-CN: 我不太在意别人怎么看我的言行。
text.en: I don't much care how others see what I say and do.

text.zh-CN: 群体的气氛好不好，对我的影响不大。
text.en: Whether a group's mood is good or bad doesn't affect me much.

text.zh-CN: 为了照顾别人的情绪而委婉说话，会让我觉得很累。
text.en: I find it tiring to soften my words just to spare someone's feelings.

text.zh-CN: 我有一套清晰的个人价值观，不会轻易因为别人而改变。
text.en: I have a clear set of personal values that I don't easily change because of others.

text.zh-CN: 做违背自己内心的事，会让我非常难受。
text.en: Doing something against my conscience makes me deeply uncomfortable.

text.zh-CN: 我很在意自己是否活得真实，而不是一味迎合别人。
text.en: It matters to me to live authentically rather than simply to please others.

text.zh-CN: 我的情感很丰富，但不一定会表露出来。
text.en: My feelings run deep, though I don't always show them.

text.zh-CN: 我喜欢用自己的方式表达个性，比如写作、艺术或穿着。
text.en: I like expressing my individuality in my own way, such as through writing, art or clothes.

text.zh-CN: 即使大多数人都同意，只要我觉得不对，我也不会附和。
text.en: Even if most people agree, I won't go along with something I feel is wrong.

text.zh-CN: 我能清楚地分辨出自己内心细微的情绪变化。
text.en: I can clearly tell apart subtle shifts in my own feelings.

text.zh-CN: 不公平的事会让我产生强烈的情绪反应。
text.en: Unfairness stirs strong feelings in me.

text.zh-CN: 我更愿意做有意义的事，而不只是有回报的事。
text.en: I'd rather do meaningful work than work that is merely rewarding.

text.zh-CN: 我的喜好和立场常常会随着身边的人而改变。
text.en: My preferences and positions often shift depending on who I'm with.

text.zh-CN: 我很少去探究自己真正的感受。
text.en: I rarely explore what I truly feel.

text.zh-CN: 对我来说，符合集体的期待比坚持个人信念更重要。
text.en: For me, meeting the group's expectations matters more than holding to personal beliefs.
